note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ANT 6, 8, Schedule 2-3, MNA 3, Const 114(c); A06b ANT 6, 8, Schedule 2-3, MNA 3, Const 114(c); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 6 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: No provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship), A02a (birth in country: Generally applicable provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory unconditionally; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states (the dataset codes no separate descent rule for a child born in the country, birth there giving it; the parent's sex is read from mode A01b). Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Antigua and Barbuda, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Antigua and Barbuda for 12 months immediately prior to the application (exemption for British protected persons), as well as during 5 out of 7 years predating the 12-month period. Periods of six months or more during which the person was not legally resident in Antigua and Barbuda shall not be taken into account. Person must have intent to reside in Antigua and Barbuda. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... No provision ... Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship ... Person is born abroad to a citizen who was born in Antigua and Barbuda, or to a citizen who is in the service of the government, or to a deceased parent who held Antigua and Barbuda citizenship. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Antigua and Barbuda unless the child is born to a foreign diplomat and neither parent is a citizen, or one of the parents is an enemy alien and the child is born in a place then under occupation by the enemy. ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a citizen who was born in Antigua and Barbuda, or to a citizen who is in the service of the government, or to a deceased parent who held Antigua and Barbuda citizenship.
